verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for an agent orchestration framework and runtime, but the pack never documents a batch API, a bulk-run endpoint, or a fan-out over many items. The closest evidence is a community note on Pregel-based parallelism and an OpenAPI listing of Stateless Runs and Crons endpoints; neither describes bulk operations across many items, so both are adjacent building blocks at best and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
